verdict.rationale: Stripe's API explicitly supports retrieving disputes, uploading evidence, and submitting responses programmatically, plus webhooks for dispute events, and Stripe offers an MCP server and CLI enabling AI agents to interact with the API — together these provide the building blocks for an agent to handle disputes end-to-end. However, there is no direct evidence of an agent-specific dispute workflow (e.g., automated evidence assembly) or documented end-to-end agent-driven dispute resolution, so this remains inferred from generic API/agent tooling docs rather than a demonstrated capability.
